content: इन्दुः [उनत्ति क्लेदयति चन्द्रिकया भुवनम् उन्द्-उ आदेरिच्च <ls>Uṇ. 1. 12</ls>] .²1 The moon; दिलीप इति राजेन्दुरिन्दुः क्षीरनिधाविव <ls>R. 1. 12</ls> (इन्दु is said to mean in the Veda a drop of Soma juice, a bright drop or spark; सुतास इन्दवः <ls>Rv. 1. 16. 6</ls>). .²2 The मृगाशिरस् Nakṣatra. .²3 (in <ab>Math.</ab>) The number ‘one’. .²4 Camphor. .²5 The point on a die; तेभ्यो व इन्दवो हविषा विधेम <ls>Av. 7. 109. 6</ls>. .²6 Designation of the अनुस्वार. -(<ab>pl.</ab>) .²1 The periodical changes of the moon. .²2 The time of moon-light, night.  .{@-ले(रे)खा@} .²1 a digit of the moon. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of several plants, especially, plant Flacourtia Sapida. Its seed is much used by women as a detergent to their oiled hair (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>बांवच्या</ns>). .²3 Ligusticum Ajwaen (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>ओंवा</ns>). see इन्दुकला.
